Description: Steps: 1) Add any course to the cart. 2) Open the cart and select Checkout. 3) Enter the mock card and select Place order. Expected: the order confirmation page loads and the enrolment is created. Actual: a 404 Not Found page is shown and no enrolment is created. Reproduced on Safari 17 / macOS Sonoma; works on Chrome.

Summary: Enrollment - Course not added to My Learning after successful payment
Description: After a successful checkout the payment is recorded but the purchased course does not appear under My Learning. Expected: the course appears in My Learning immediately after payment. Actual: My Learning still shows the previous course count.

Summary: Registration - Step 2 accepts a password shorter than 8 characters
Description: On Step 2 of the registration wizard a 5-character password is accepted and the wizard advances to Step 3. Expected: passwords under 8 characters are rejected with an inline validation error. Actual: the account is created with a weak password.

Summary: Catalogue search - Multi-keyword query returns no results for a valid course
Description: Searching the catalogue for 'data analytics fundamentals' returns an empty results state even though the course exists. Single-keyword searches work. Expected: matching courses are listed. Actual: the no-results message is shown.

Summary: Catalogue filter - 'Advanced' level filter also lists Beginner courses
Description: Filtering the catalogue by Level: Advanced also returns several Beginner courses. Expected: only Advanced courses are listed. Actual: the list is cluttered with Beginner courses, though enrolment still works.

Summary: Admin course edit - 'Save changes' silently fails when Instructor ID is blank
Description: In Admin course edit, selecting Save changes does nothing when the Instructor ID field is left blank. Expected: the form saves, or an inline validation error appears. Actual: nothing happens and no error is shown.

Summary: Dashboard - greeting shows email address instead of learner name
Description: The dashboard greeting reads 'Welcome back, learner@example.com' instead of the learner's name. Expected: 'Welcome back, [name].' Actual: the email address is displayed in place of the name.

Summary: Course detail - price displays without a currency symbol
Description: The course price on the detail page renders as '49.00' with no currency symbol. Expected: a currency-formatted price such as '$49.00'. Actual: the number renders with no symbol.

Summary: Account - 'Cancel' button misaligned below 'Save changes' on settings page
Description: On the Account settings page the Cancel button sits a few pixels below the Save changes button. Both buttons work. Expected: the buttons share the same baseline. Actual: Cancel is visibly misaligned.

Summary: Cart - removing one course clears the entire cart
Description: Removing a single course from a cart that holds multiple courses empties the whole cart. Expected: only the selected course is removed. Actual: all courses are removed and the cart is empty.
